scripts.start:api: cd equipment-control-api && set PORT=3000&& npm run start:dev
scripts.start:front: cd frontend && set PORT=3001&& set REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:3000&& npm start
scripts.start:all: start "equipment-api" cmd /k "cd equipment-control-api && set PORT=3000&& npm run start:dev" && start "equipment-front" cmd /k "cd frontend && set PORT=3001&& set REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:3000&& npm start"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../equipment-control-api && npm run build
scripts.install: npm install && cd equipment-control-api && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
